title: TripleResponse
description: A subject-predicate-object triple from the knowledge graph, with optional epistemic provenance (#347): why to believe it, and typed ids for tool-verified triples.

evidence.description: Verbatim span the triple was read from (empty when unknown).

chunk_id.description: Chunk that produced the triple (empty when unknown).

confidence.description: 0 unknown, 1 LLM-plausible, 2 corroborated by a tool, 3 verified against a structured source. An LLM-derived triple is never above 1.

subject_id.description: Optional typed id for the subject, e.g. bvbrc:genome:<id>.

object_id.description: Optional typed id for the object, e.g. bvbrc:genome:<id>.
